data.exact_reserve_text: The movements in 2016 have been affected by the change in the Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75% causing deteriorations in the gross position. The net impact to the syndicate is reduced due to the benefit of reinsurance.

named_events.loss_description: Revision of Ogden discount rate increased gross claims outstanding by GBP 155.750m with reinsurers' share GBP 122.281m, producing a net adverse impact of GBP 33.469m to the syndicate's results.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 were GBP 570.85m. During 2016 there was adverse prior-year development (strengthening) of approximately GBP 56.55m (c.9.9% of opening reserves). The deterioration was driven principally by changes in valuation assumptions related to the Ogden discount rate which materially increased long-tail motor liabilities; reinsurance recoveries mitigated a large portion of the gross deterioration.
raw_causal_phrases: The movements in 2016 have been affected by the change in the Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75% causing deteriorations in the gross position.
The net impact to the syndicate is reduced due to the benefit of reinsurance.
Further inflation in claims costs: External factors could continue to increase claims costs, such as the depreciation of the pound affecting the prices of imported parts.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year movement note published figures are presented on a net basis; a gross prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development (triangle) because the movement note only provided net values. The triangle contains an aggregate '2010 and prior' column which was excluded per instructions. The mapping of the PYD to 'Motor' is an inference since the syndicate is motor-specialist and the segmental mix shows Motor as dominant. Small negative premium for 'Accident and health' appears in the statutory table (GBP 2k) and is treated as negligible.
